craft_notes: Sthāyin: needless grace. Rows: exemption then display. Read aloud: free hand.

lines: Though the truth-rooted owe no penance at all,
yet to grace the conduct-only freed, display the conduct's course.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yady api tattvajñānaniṣṭhasya prāyaścittādi na kiṃcit tathāpi caryāmātrād eva mokṣabhāginaḥ tān anugrahītum ācāravartanīṃ darśayet
